title: gentiana pneumonanthe subsp. depressa
intro: Gentiana pneumonanthe subsp. depressa, commonly known as a variety of the lesser gentian, is a flowering plant that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana pneumonanthe subsp. depressa include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and amarogentin, which are known for their medicinal properties.
